purpose: The explicit wrapper retains its outer Token argument after the inner Generator call. A producer clears the sole capture; the body unsets its received copy. Outer argument destruction then sees capture/Gen live, records only destructor/caller frames and throws a supplied Stop before capture retirement closes Gen. Body trace includes both native API and outer Closure wrapper.
source:
<?php
class Stop113P extends Exception {}
class Token113P {
    function __construct() { global $weakToken; $weakToken = WeakReference::create($this); }
    function __destruct() {
        global $weakGenerator, $weakCapture, $weakToken, $stop;
        echo 'DTOR|', $weakGenerator->get() instanceof Generator, '|', $weakCapture->get() instanceof Closure, '|', $weakToken->get() === $this, '|';
        $probe = new Exception('destructor'); $trace = $probe->getTrace();
        echo 'DTRACE|', $trace[0]['function'] === '__destruct', '|', $trace[0]['class'] === 'Token113P', '|', $trace[1]['function'] === 'run113P', '|', !isset($trace[2]), '|';
        unset($trace, $probe); throw $stop;
    }
}
function stream113P() {
    global $weakGenerator, $weakCapture, $weakToken;
    try {
        echo 'INIT|'; $received = yield 'head';
        echo 'BODY|', $received === $weakToken->get(), '|', $weakGenerator->get() instanceof Generator, '|', $weakCapture->get() instanceof Closure, '|';
        $probe = new Exception('body'); $trace = $probe->getTrace();
        echo 'BTRACE|', $trace[0]['function'] === 'stream113P', '|', $trace[1]['class'] === 'Generator', '|', $trace[1]['function'] === 'send', '|', $trace[2]['class'] === 'Closure', '|', $trace[2]['function'] === '__invoke', '|', $trace[3]['function'] === 'run113P', '|', !isset($trace[4]), '|';
        unset($trace, $probe, $received); yield 'tail'; echo 'BAD-RESUME|';
    } finally { echo 'FIN|', $weakGenerator->get() instanceof Generator, '|', $weakCapture->get() === null, '|'; }
}
function pack113P() { global $capture, $pack; echo 'PACK|'; $saved = $pack; $capture = null; $pack = null; return $saved; }
function run113P() { global $capture; echo 'CALL|'; $result = $capture->__invoke(...pack113P()); echo 'BAD-RETURN|'; }
$stop = new Stop113P('given'); $generator = stream113P(); $weakGenerator = WeakReference::create($generator);
$capture = $generator->send(...); $weakCapture = WeakReference::create($capture); $generator = null;
$token = new Token113P(); $pack = ['value' => $token]; $token = null;
try { run113P(); echo 'BAD-CALLER|'; }
catch (Stop113P $caught) {
    echo 'CATCH|', $caught === $stop, '|', $caught->getPrevious() === null, '|', $caught->getTrace() === [], '|', $weakGenerator->get() === null, '|', $weakCapture->get() === null, '|', $weakToken->get() === null, '|', $capture === null, '|', $pack === null, '|';
}
echo 'DONE|';
